title: Partner Workshop Records and the Evidence Minimum on a Damage Report
content:
Where a vehicle protected by the Keyturn Host Protection Plan is also kept under a Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan, the workshop's own record of the vehicle stands for part of the evidence a damage report would otherwise carry, and the share of the plan's evidence minimum the report must carry is read off the care plan's standing and the completed workshop visits on that vehicle.

### The rule

1. Where the vehicle carries an active care plan and two or more workshop visits on it have been completed in the six months before the report, the evidence minimum is taken at half and rounded up to a whole document, the workshop's own record standing for the rest.
2. Where the vehicle carries an active care plan and fewer than two workshop visits on it have been completed in that period, the evidence minimum is taken at three quarters and rounded up to a whole document.
3. Where the vehicle carries no active care plan, the evidence minimum is taken as published.

### Input, judgement, output (hypothetical figures)

| Care plan on the vehicle | Completed visits in the six months before | Evidence minimum of 10 becomes |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 3 | 5 |
| Active | 1 | 8 |
| None | any number | 10 |

The middle row shows the rounding: three quarters of 10 is 7.5, and the rounding is upward to a whole document, so the report carries 8. The same rounding applies to the half: on an evidence minimum of 9, half is 4.5 and the report carries 5.

### Where the reading is taken from

The standing of the care plan and the workshop visits completed on that vehicle are read from the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan held on the same vehicle, counting only visits completed within the six months before the report.
